title: Station state post
description: The body of POST /api/station/state, as the station sends it today (StationLink._state, sizeup/cloud/station.py). The latest post wins and nothing is queued: it is the station's heartbeat, who is talking now, the page going out now and, about every 5 s, its whole status. Plain JSON, never gzipped, with a Content-Length; the hub takes at most 4 MiB. Times are Unix seconds (a fraction allowed), never milliseconds. Two variants: without `status` (sent at once when the talkers change, and every 2 s while someone talks) and with `status`.

at.description: The station's clock when it built this post, Unix seconds with a fraction (never milliseconds: the hub would take them as a clock 50,000 years ahead). The hub keeps (its own clock - at) as this station's clock skew, in seconds; it stamps the snapshot with its own clock.

talking.description: Everyone transmitting now, and whoever just finished and was not shown live. The whole list every time ([] when nobody talks). The hub keeps the first 50 entries and drops the snapshot when it is older than 8 s. The hub reads `paging` only when `talking` is present.

paging.description: The two-tone pages going out now, newest first. The whole list every time ([] when none). The hub keeps the first 8 entries.

talker.title: One talker
talker.description: One radio transmitting now, on a P25 talkgroup or an analog FM channel (sizeup/radio/live.py).

key.description: Stable id of this entry while it lasts: `p25:<system name>:<call key>:<radio id>` or `fm:<channel>:<since, 2 decimals>:<radio id>`. Opaque to the hub.

system.description: The kind of radio system. The hub looks the radio up in its own registry under P25 unless this is `fm`.

channel.description: The talkgroup's name (P25) or the channel's label (FM).

tg.description: The P25 talkgroup number; null on an FM channel.

radio_id.description: The transmitting radio's id as decoded (P25 unit id, MDC-1200 or FleetSync id), digits as a string; "" when not known yet.

alias.description: The radio's over-the-air alias (P25); "" when none.

rig.description: The unit the station's registry gives this radio; "" when unknown. The hub replaces it from its own registry whenever `radio_id` is set.

label.description: The registry's label for the radio; replaced on the hub like `rig`.

since.description: When the call or the carrier started, Unix seconds.

talk_since.description: When this radio started talking within the call, Unix seconds.

ended.description: True for a talker who just finished and is flashed until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended entry is still shown; null while talking.

dispatcher.description: The alias looks like a dispatch console.

main.description: The talkgroup is one of the main ones (always true on FM).

id_on_release.description: FM entries only: the carrier is open and no id was decoded yet (these radios send it when the key is released).

page.title: One page going out
page.description: A two-tone page as it is decoded, pair by pair (sizeup/radio/livepage.py). The hub drops an entry without a `pairs` list.

started.description: When the first tone started, Unix seconds.

pairs.description: The tone pairs decoded so far, in order.

items.title: One tone pair
items.description: One A/B tone pair of the page.

names.description: Who this pair pages, by name; [] for a pair the station does not know.

ours.description: The pair pages one of this department's own.

phase.description: `tones` while pairs are still coming, `voice` once the dispatcher speaks.

ended.description: The page is over; shown until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended page is still shown; null while it goes out.

page_id.description: The id of the finished page this became; "" until then.

status.title: Station status
status.description: Everything else the station reports, about every 5 s and right after it ran a job (StationLink.status). The hub keeps the whole object as the station's latest status, replaces `id` with the authenticated id and takes `talkgroups` out into its own list. Objects marked x-complete list every key the station sends; the few that are not are named as known gaps in contracts/README.md.

id.description: The station id this post claims: the config's until the hub's answer names another (`station`). It must be the id the bearer token proves, else 401 `id_mismatch`. At most 64 printable characters; a station with its own token has `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}`.

config_id.description: `[station] id` from the station's config file. The hub uses it to forget a renamed station's former ids once the config has caught up.

radios.description: One row per receiver and service, in order: each FM / AM channel, the county P25 system, each other P25 system, speech-to-text (`STT`), the dispatch voice (`Voice`). The station's own `Hub` row is left out.

items.title: One radio row
items.description: A receiver's or service's state (App.radio_status). Every row has the eight common keys. An FM row (sizeup/radio/fm.py) adds the squelch's numbers; one with the noise squelch also `min_open_s`, `short_per_min`, `squelch_default`, `channel_kind`. An AM airband row (sizeup/radio/am.py) is an FM row with `am`, `freqs`, `now`. The county P25 row (sizeup/radio/p25.py) and the `STT` and `Voice` rows have the common keys only; another P25 system's row (sizeup/radio/systems.py) adds `system`.

label.description: The row's name: a channel's label, a P25 system's, `STT` or `Voice`.

mhz.description: The channel's frequency, MHz; null for a row that is not one frequency.

state.description: The row's state in a word.

detail.description: A sentence for people about the state.

restarts.description: How many times the receiver's program was restarted since the station started.

last_heard.description: When it last received something, Unix seconds; null for never.

quieting_db.description: FM: how far the noise is quieted now, dB; null when not measured.

word.description: A short word shown in place of the state (`RX hold`, `no audio`), only when there is one.

open_s.description: FM / AM: how long the squelch has been open without a break, seconds; null when closed.

stuck.description: FM / AM: open for longer than a transmission can be.

open_db.description: FM / AM: the squelch opens at this much quieting, dB.

close_db.description: FM / AM: the squelch closes below this much quieting, dB.

hiss_db.description: FM / AM: the idle hiss the quieting is measured from, relative dB; null until measured.

floor_db.description: FM / AM: the channel's noise floor, relative dB; null until measured.

min_open_s.description: FM noise squelch only: the shortest opening kept, seconds.

short_per_min.description: FM noise squelch only: openings shorter than `min_open_s`, per minute.

squelch_default.title: Squelch defaults
squelch_default.description: FM noise squelch only: the receiver's own defaults.

open_db.description: Opens at this much quieting, dB.

close_db.description: Closes below this much quieting, dB.

channel_kind.description: FM noise squelch only: the channel's kind from the config (`paging`, `traffic`); "" when unknown.

keyups.description: FM traffic channels only: counts of recent key-ups with no speech (App.keyups). Not typed here.

am.description: AM airband rows only: always true.

schedule.description: AM rows whose frequency changes by the time of day: the plan in words.

multichannel.description: AM rows with more than one frequency: they are received at once on one dongle.

freqs.description: AM rows: each frequency it listens on now.

items.title: One airband frequency
items.description: One frequency an AM receiver listens on.

name.description: A name for it by the time of day (e.g. `CTAF` while a tower is closed); "" for none.

quieting_db.description: The carrier over the noise now, dB; null when not measured.

elsewhere.description: Another receiver has this frequency now: it is not received here.

now.description: AM rows: the frequencies it is on now, in words.

tower.title: Tower hours
tower.description: AM rows on a tower's or ground's frequency: the tower now.

next.description: The local time it next opens or closes, `HH:MM`.

capture.title: Wideband capture
capture.description: AM rows received through the channelizer: the capture.

rate.description: Its sample rate, samples per second.

realtime_pct.description: Samples processed against real time, percent; only once measured.

fallback_until.description: AM rows that fell back to one frequency: until when, Unix seconds.

ab.description: AM rows with an on-air A/B comparison running: its state. Not typed here.

system.description: Rows of the other P25 systems only: the system's name.

hold_until.description: Rows of the other P25 systems only: held back after dropouts until this time, Unix seconds.

sdr.title: Shared dongles
sdr.description: The shared dongles and what each is set to (App.sdr). null when every channel has a dongle of its own.

shared.description: Always true: the object is only there for shared dongles.

mode.description: The job of the first dongle (kept for a hub from before several dongles).

modes.description: Every job a dongle can be set to, `Off` last.

now.description: Per AM job, the frequencies it is on now, in words; {} for none.

switching.description: A switch of a dongle's job is under way.

adsb.description: The dongle reserved for the ADS-B receiver, its decoder and the forwarding to the hub (App.adsb_row): `serial`, `name`, `present`, `product`, `source`, `held_by`, `installed`, `gain`, `bias_tee`, `decoder`, `forward`. Not typed here.

duplicates.description: Serials two or more dongles share; [] for none.

items.title: One shared serial
items.description: Two or more dongles with the same serial (App.usb).

job.description: The job set for that serial.

rename.description: The index of the one to give a new serial, when that can be told; else null.

was.description: The product that serial was last seen as; "" when unknown.

items.title: One dongle
items.description: One RTL-SDR dongle and its job.

name.description: Its name here (the serial when none was given).

product.description: Its USB product name; "" when it is not plugged in.

mode.description: The job it is set to, or `Off`.

ambiguous.description: Why nothing may open it now (two dongles share its serial); "" when fine.

set_by.description: Who chose its job: `person`, `auto`, or null (a default).

lent.title: Lent to a reception test
lent.description: While a reception test has the dongle; null otherwise.

job.description: The job it runs for the test; "" once the test is over.

owed.description: Its own job is not back yet.

held_by.title: Holder
held_by.description: Another application's claim on the dongle.

mode.description: What it says it uses the dongle for.

noaudio.title: No audio
noaudio.description: The dongle opens but streams no audio; null otherwise.

retry_min.description: When it is tried again, minutes after `since`.

group.description: Its antenna group's name; absent outside groups.

own.description: A stand-in only: its own job, kept aside while it runs another's.

for.description: A stand-in only: the dongles it stands in for.

on.description: Its job runs on this stand-in dongle instead.

groups.description: The antenna groups; [] when there are none.

items.title: One antenna group
items.description: Dongles on one antenna feed, locked to the jobs it carries.

parked.description: Its jobs switched off on purpose; only when there are any.

usable.description: Its dongles that can run a job now.

short.description: Its jobs that have no dongle now.

unowned.description: Its jobs that are no dongle's own and not parked.

conflicts.description: Dongles that run a job against the group, {serial: job}.

no_park.description: The jobs that may not be parked.

groups_problem.description: Why the groups file was dropped; "" when fine.

rerun.title: Re-run progress
rerun.description: The re-transcription the hub asked for, as counts of clips.

total.description: Clips asked for in this run.

changed.description: Of those, how many got another text.

pending.description: Clips still waiting, the catch-up's left out.

channels.title: Channel choices applied
channels.description: The per-channel choices the hub sent, as this station runs them (App.channels_applied). The hub compares `sig` with its own and sends the choices again when they differ.

prefs.description: Per channel key, the choices in force as the hub sent them; {} for none.

aws.description: What the hub last said about Amazon Transcribe, as the station holds it: `ok` (boolean), `why` (text), `reserve` (channel keys), and `deny` when the hub sent one. Not typed here: it is the hub's own words back.

tones.description: How many tone-code choices are in force (a count, not the list).

squelch.description: Per FM channel label, the squelch numbers the hub set; {} for none.

squelch_ok.description: This station takes squelch settings from the hub. An implicit capability flag: the hub sends them only when it is true.

deny_ok.description: This station takes `aws.deny` from the hub. An implicit capability flag, like `squelch_ok`.

sig.description: A short hex digest of everything above (sizeup/channels.py sig), compared for equality only.

p25_systems.description: The other P25 systems this station runs (sizeup/radio/systems.py state). [] when none. The key's presence is an implicit capability flag: the hub treats a status without it as a station from before the other systems.

items.title: One P25 system
items.description: A P25 system beside the county's: its jobs, what runs, its control channel and what that showed.

name.description: The system's short name, lower case.

site.description: The site as its config gives it (NAC, WACN, phase); {} when not given. Not typed here.

items.title: One job
items.description: One trunk-recorder source of the system.

source.description: Its index among the system's sources.

sdr.description: The dongle that has it; null for none.

frequencies.description: Its control and voice frequencies, MHz.

covered.description: Those the running jobs take in, MHz.

last_heard.description: When a call of it last ended, Unix seconds; null for never.

hold_until.description: Held back after dropouts until this time, Unix seconds; null when not.

cc.title: Control channel
cc.description: Its control channel's decode; null while no job of it runs.

rate.description: Messages decoded per second lately; null when none was logged lately.

low_since.description: Since when the rate has been low, Unix seconds; null when it is not.

last_low.description: When it was last low, Unix seconds; null for never.

last_retune.description: When it last retuned, Unix seconds; null for never.

silent_since.description: Since when nothing at all was logged, Unix seconds; null when it is logging.

unknown.description: Talkgroups heard that its file does not list: {tg, source, count, first, last}.

encrypted.description: Recent key-ups on encrypted talkgroups: {tg, name, source, ...}, never the radio.

watched.description: Counts on the talkgroups being watched: {tg, name, since, grants, ...}.

split.description: Counts of the cuts the recorder made, or would have made, where a new talker came in on the voice channel (sizeup/radio/systems.py state): a count per kind, and `since`. Optional: a station from before the P25 split sends none.

since.description: When the counts began, Unix seconds.

reception.title: Reception test
reception.description: The reception test (sizeup/radio/reception.py state): what can be tested, the running test, the past ones. null when this station has no P25 system to test.

systems.description: The systems a test can run on: {name, label, kind, jobs, watch, alert, caveat}.

durations.description: The lengths offered, minutes (0: until stopped).

keep_min.description: How long samples are kept, minutes.

dongles.description: Each dongle and whether it may be lent: {serial, name, job, present, held_by, protected, refuse}.

active.description: The running test; null for none. Not typed here.

alert.description: A job a test paused that is still paused, in words; null for none.

samples.description: Calls the running test captured, to listen to.

history.description: The past tests, newest first. The hub logs each ended one once, keyed by `id` and `restored`.

items.title: One past test
items.description: A reception test that ended (or was interrupted).

minutes.description: Minutes per job; 0 for until stopped.

ended.description: When it ended, Unix seconds; null while it has not.

verdict.description: The overall verdict {grade, hint}, or null.

restored.description: What happened to the paused job afterwards, in words; null until known.

halves.description: Each job's numbers: {job, seconds, grade, hint, cc_mhz, rate, decoded_pct, ...}.

stt_terms.title: Term lists applied
stt_terms.description: The versions of the private term lists the hub sent for whisper's prompt (never the terms). The hub sends the lists again when `v` differs from its own.

v.description: The version of the lists in force; "" for none.

sets.description: Per list name, its own version; present once the hub has sent any.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.description: The durable queue of events waiting to go up (sizeup/cloud/outbox.py).

oldest.description: When the oldest waiting event was queued, Unix seconds; null when none waits.

dropped_audio.description: Clips whose audio was dropped to keep the outbox under its size limit (the events stayed).

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: The events the hub refused and the station set aside (Outbox.summary, sizeup/cloud/outbox.py; #762): counts, per kind, and the newest rows, the critical first. Kinds, states, reasons and the hub's error only, never an event's data. Optional: a station from before #762 sends none.

critical.description: Of them, critical ones (sent again, slowly).

evicted.description: Non-critical ones dropped this run to keep the quarantine under its bound.

too_large_audio.description: Clips left off events the hub refused as too large with them (Outbox.strip_audio): the event was sent again without its clip. This run only. Not the outbox's own size limit (that is dropped_audio).

kinds.description: Per event type: {n, critical, stuck, late, critical_first, minor_first, minor_last}: the counts, and when the critical and the other ones were first and last refused (Unix seconds or null). Health's alerts are decided from these.

rows.description: The newest quarantined events (at most 10), the critical first: {id, kind, reason, error, first_at, last_at, tries, critical, next_at, state}. `reason` is the hub's (malformed | apply_failed) or the station's own; `error` is empty for an incident source's event (it may quote the county's data).

stt_input.title: Speech-to-text inputs
stt_input.description: The lane that sends each clip's exact speech-to-text input to the hub (sizeup/cloud/sttinput.py; StationLink.stt_stats). Counts are since the station started.

waiting.description: Encoded inputs waiting to go up.

dropped.description: Inputs dropped, by reason: `queue`, `too_big`, `failed` (the encoder's), `outbox` (over its budget), `refused` (by the hub, for good). Each a count.

dropped_pre.description: Of the dropped, those of pre-alert channels.

dropped_fire.description: Of the dropped, those of fire channels.

encoder.description: Where inputs are encoded: "" before the first, else `scope`, `process` or `thread (<why>)`.

held.description: Lower-priority inputs are held now because whisper is behind on live traffic.

detail.description: What was last said about it.

unhealthy.description: The worker is alive but not answering in time.

in_flight.description: An input is being encoded now.

pool_worker.title: Whisper as a pool worker
pool_worker.description: This station's whisper as one of the hub's speech-to-text pool workers (sizeup/cloud/stationworker.py). Counts are since the station started.

preempted.description: Jobs aborted for one of the station's own clips.

why.description: Why it is off or paused; "" when online.

stt_alert_rev.description: The revision of the pre-alert source list this station has: a content hash of the set as an integer below 2^53 (sizeup/intel/engine.py push_rev), 0 until the hub has sent one. The hub sends its list again when the number differs from its own. The key's presence is an implicit capability flag: a station without it is never sent the list.

version.title: Version and update
version.description: The build this station runs, the hub's build as it last heard it, and the updater's state (sizeup/cloud/autoupdate.py Watch.status; StationLink.version).

build.description: The git sha this station runs; "" when unknown (a development checkout).

hub.description: The hub's build as its state answers gave it (7 to 40 lower-case hex); "" when not heard or not a sha.

update.title: Updater state
update.description: The updater's own state file, cut to these keys (each but `failed` only when the file has it). Its values are the local file's and are not typed here.

state.description: The updater's state in a word.

to.description: The build it is switching to.

windows.description: The quiet windows it waits for.

last.description: The last update: what, when, how long.

equivalent.description: Builds with no runtime change between them.

retry.description: Per target, why it is tried again.

failed.description: Per target sha, why the update to it failed (the newest five); {} for none.

adapter.title: Incident-source adapter
adapter.description: The private incident-source adapter this release runs. Names and states only: never a credential, a URL or a value read from the source.

repo.description: The adapter repository's short name; "" when off.

commit.description: The installed commit, at most 12 hex characters; "" when none.

health.description: Each incident source's own health, as its runner last reported it.

state.description: `starting` before the first report, then the runner's word (`ok`, `backing_off`, `failing`, ...).

logship.title: Journal shipper
logship.description: The journal shipper's state and counters (sizeup/cloud/logship.py stats). When reading them fails: {state: `error`, reason: <the error's type name>}.

state.description: Its state in a word; `error` when reading the counters failed.

adapter.description: The incident-source adapter's lines are shipped too.

dropped_secret.description: Lines dropped for looking like a secret.

dropped_spool.description: Lines dropped because the spool was full.

dropped_adapter.description: The incident-source adapter's lines, kept here.

dropped_off.description: Lines dropped while shipping is off.

rejected.description: Batches the hub refused for good.

last_ok.description: When the hub last took a batch, Unix seconds; null for never.

metrics.title: Signal-metrics link
metrics.description: The signal-metrics sender's counters (sizeup/cloud/metrics.py). No reader of this object was found on the hub.

dropped.description: Records dropped (the memory buffer was full).

last_ok.description: When the hub last took a batch, Unix seconds; null for never.

health.title: Machine and programs
health.description: The machine and its radio programs (sizeup/cloud/health.py station_metrics). When building it fails the object is {error} alone.

started.description: When this process started, Unix seconds.

boot.description: When the machine booted, Unix seconds; null when not known.

cpu_pct.description: CPU busy since the last report, percent of all cores; null on the first report and where it cannot be read.

load1.description: The 1-minute load average; null where there is none.

mem_pct.description: Memory in use, percent; null where it cannot be read.

mem_total.description: Installed memory, bytes; null where it cannot be read.

temp_c.description: The hottest thermal zone, degrees Celsius; null without one.

disk_path.description: The folder whose disk is measured.

disk_pct.description: That disk in use, percent; null when it cannot be read.

recorder.title: County trunk-recorder
recorder.description: The county P25 system's trunk-recorder; only on a station with P25.

detail.description: A sentence for people, radio ids removed.

cc.title: Control channel
cc.description: A P25 control channel's decode, from trunk-recorder's log.

rate.description: Messages decoded per second lately; null when none was logged lately.

low_since.description: Since when the rate has been low, Unix seconds; null when it is not.

last_low.description: When it was last low, Unix seconds; null for never.

last_retune.description: When it last retuned, Unix seconds; null for never.

silent_since.description: Since when nothing at all was logged, Unix seconds; null when it is logging.

stt_queue.description: The speech-to-text queue's depth, waits and drops (sizeup/stt.py stats). Not typed here.

jobs.description: Per job label, its program. The hub reads it as an object: a list is not one.

additionalProperties.title: One job's program
additionalProperties.description: A receiver's program as it really runs.

state.description: Its state in a word; `off` for a job no dongle has.

detail.description: A sentence for people, radio ids removed.

expected.description: It should be running (a dongle has the job, or dongles are not shared).

context.description: A job of another P25 system: never an alert on the hub.

hold_until.description: Held back after dropouts until this time, Unix seconds.

reception.description: A job a reception test paused that is still paused: {job, sdr, since, text, push}; null for none.

items.title: One USB dongle
items.description: A dongle as USB lists it.

duplicates.description: Serials two or more of them share.

items.title: One shared serial
items.description: Two or more dongles with the same serial (App.usb).

job.description: The job set for that serial.

rename.description: The index of the one to give a new serial, when that can be told; else null.

was.description: The product that serial was last seen as; "" when unknown.

heard.description: Per main talkgroup heard since the start, keyed `tg:<n>`: its last call. For the hub's silence hints.

adsb.description: The ADS-B receiver's dongle, decoder and forwarding (adsb_health); only while a dongle is named for it. Not typed here.

link_restarts.description: From #782 on, and only when there are any: per thread of the hub link (`hub-state`, `hub-forward`, ...) that ended on an error and was started again, how often and why. Not sent by the code before #782.

additionalProperties.description: A thread of the hub link that ended and was started again.

talkgroups.description: Every known or heard P25 talkgroup with its switches (sizeup/talkgroups.py state). Sent only when a row's (tg, record, main, system, tier) changed, or every 30 s; when absent the hub keeps the list it has. [] for a station without P25.

items.title: One talkgroup
items.description: One talkgroup of the county system or of another one.

main.description: It is one of the main talkgroups.

count.description: Calls heard since the station started.

last.description: When it was last heard, Unix seconds; null for never.

key.description: Its channel key for the speech-to-text choices (`tg:<n>` for the county's, `p25:<system>:<n>` otherwise).

service.description: Its service: the admins' choice for this source, else the automatic one.

service_auto.description: The automatic service, from the file's group and tag.

department.description: The department it belongs to; "" when none.

tier.description: Another system's talkgroup: its tier (`alert`, `text`, `record`, ...); null for the county system's own switches. The hub adds `tier_set` (tier is not null) when the row has none.
